columns: Units, ability to disable and result

rows.Units, ability to disable and result: Internal checkpoint/edge/node/rule work, not axiom count. Safe integer only; no `null`/Infinity disable. Shared across closure and optional source pass
Structural traversal includes arrays and object fields; also used by XSD-pattern validation. Cannot configure a higher value
JavaScript UTF-16 string length of a visited literal; not UTF-8 bytes; no disable sentinel
Facet numeric arithmetic checks raw lexical string length, including punctuation/signs; not a cap on every integer literal
Null disables only elapsed deadline. Explicit nonnegative safe integer permits a deadline; zero remains a deadline

Arrays and structural field edges count towards depth. Private defaults; no public override on changes/duplicator/renamer/Manchester renderer. Annotation overflow is mislabeled `expressionDepth`, limit 512
Checks each rendered string's UTF-8 size, with a string-length precheck. No caller override
Structural validation before mapping; 1,000,000 direct axioms; mapping 5,000,000 quads; parser/reconstruction budgets later. No save-level override

Term/output/construction byte gates; QName work counts UTF-16 candidate characters, not output bytes. Conservative construction and indentation checks can reject a smaller final text. It can flatten owned chains/lists at the nesting boundary, so graph depth over 128 does not imply failure
DOM-construction values and final output are checked separately; no public override

Both Turtle and RDFXML call `compareOntologies` with its private default. Requires positive safe integer internally; default/null handling is not unlimited. Throws `OntologyStructuralComparisonLimitError` with code `ONTOLOGY_STRUCTURAL_COMPARISON_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, then a storage error
All disabled by default. Optional values are nonnegative safe integers; one extraction budget spans preparation and every STAR pass. Constructor work precedes these options and is synchronous

Private context-resolution chain/cycle-set gate, not a global cap on arbitrary independent contexts. Its `>` check admits 11 loader calls on the tested chain before the next resolution fails. Not a loader-configuration field

rows.Default or fixed bound: engine stack, maximum strings/arrays, available memory
rows.Units, ability to disable and result: Not a supported library numerical API. Functional's recursive renderer and parts of mapping/dependency work remain subject to these constraints

columns: Default and semantics in the pinned source

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: 20,000 milliseconds; copy on change, return same object if unchanged; setter stores negative ints too, but `URLConnection.setConnectTimeout` rejects negatives at use. Zero means no connection timeout in URLConnection
rows.JS implication: Do not rename `timeoutMs` to this: it currently bounds computation. Reuse this API and its units/stage/domain where transport is implemented

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: 5; setter stores arbitrary ints; helper's loop bound counts attempts. Zero/negative means no input-stream attempt; repeated timeouts stop at the hardcoded fifth failure
rows.JS implication: `maxRetries = 0` is neither the default nor the effective Java semantics, and JS does not consume it itself

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: true; controls OWLAPI's explicit cross-protocol redirect handling with cycle detection. The code does not call `setInstanceFollowRedirects(false)` when false
rows.JS implication: Do not infer that false forbids every same-protocol redirect handled by HttpURLConnection. Preserve actual backend behavior or define an explicitly chosen adapted contract

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: `"100000000"`; passed to native SAX property setup. Setter stores strings; parsing/invalid-value behavior belongs to the selected SAX provider. Zero was accepted by the observed parser and disables this count limit
rows.JS implication: The four JS entity fields count different things. They cannot be aliases for this Java API
JS defaults to `parsingMode: "strict"`; `compatible` is not proven to be an exact inverse implementation of Java strictness

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: true; stored loader configuration also affects later manager annotation-axiom changes
rows.JS implication: Setting only parse-time behavior in JS loses a Java post-load effect

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: `THROW_EXCEPTION`; silent mode catches ontology-creation failures from imports and notifies listeners
rows.JS implication: JS `"diagnostic"` only absorbs its defined missing-import cases; parse failures and generic loader failures can still abort

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: Copy-based configured set plus built-in default ignored namespaces
rows.JS implication: Reusing locally managed documents is not a substitute for this policy

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: Per-instance override → process system property → classpath `owlapi.properties` → enum default
rows.JS implication: Default resolution is dynamic for system properties. JS snapshots a fixed object without this authority hierarchy

rows.Default and semantics in the pinned sour: Java format parameter bag; Rio copies supported `RioSetting` values into its parser configuration
rows.JS implication: An existing Java seam for dependency controls. JS exposes immutable JSON-compatible parameters, primarily string-keyed selected settings
